64 CC0 one-shots, 12 original one-bar arrangements.
18 newly curated acoustic recordings: 6 kicks, 6 snares, 6 hats.

All source/license evidence and compact PCM included in the complete source archive.
Code GPL-3.0-only; fonts SIL OFL.
